lore.bio:
Bold, brash, fiery and fierce, Kairi Imahara isn’t above greasing palms and bending the law. When she was a child, she stole a Titan. It belonged to her dad, a mercenary and former Apex Predator named Viper. She wanted to be just like him when she grew up. But the next day he left on a mission and never returned.
In some ways, she still followed in his footsteps: it wasn't a Titan, but her ship offered a decent, dubiously ethical living. During the day, she smuggled precious cargo, and at night, went shot for shot with the outlaws and mercs in the bars. But even though she had her ladies, her liquor, and her love of the sky, she was still obsessed with finding the man who’d put her father in harm’s way: his commander, Kuben Blisk.
She tracked Blisk down to the Outlands, prepared to kill him. But he spoke of her father with respect, and challenged her to be better. She shot him anyway. 
...but not to kill. Knowing she could get to him was enough. Well, that, and the Apex Games card she took from Blisk’s grasp served as a decent enough trophy. Using the intact flight core from Viper’s Northstar, she built a sleek new jetpack that honored her father’s memory. And that was when Kairi could finally soar on her own, and in a version of her dad’s Titan, that ended up being hers after all.

For more information on Valkyrie's story, see Valkyrie (character).

passive.name: Recon Legend
passive.description: Press the jump key while in the air to engage jetpack. You can switch between hold and toggle mode in the options menu. Gains Threat Vision while jetpacking, which stays on until your feet hit the ground or you zipline.

tactical.name: Missile Swarm
tactical.description: Fire a swarm of mini-rockets that damage and disorient the enemy with a short full body scan on hit. Tac damage now puts movement passives on cooldown.

ultimate.name: Skyward Dive
ultimate.description: Press once to prepare for launch. Teammates can interact with Valkyrie to join the launch. Press again to launch into the air and skydive, reaching a 15% increased height.

details: [Perks] Fix -> Fixed the ultimate being blocked by a Trident and leaving the scan on permanently
[Base] Fix -> Fixed issue where tactical could be interrupted by melee
[Passive] Buff -> Jetpack cooldown and fly speed reworked.

[Tactical] Buff -> Missile Swarm: removed self damage and stun effect, added short full body scan on hit, tac damage now puts movement passives on cooldown, removed 5 seconds of cooldown, removed vertical clearance firing restriction, improved missile pathing to work better in some situations such as low clearance situations (firing indoors or at targets under a bridge), increased max range.

[Ultimate] Buff -> Skyward Dive: increased launch height 15% (integrated Afterburners upgrade), reduced cooldown by 30 seconds, reduced delay before takeoff, slightly reduced time slowly rising before takeoff, removed self cancel cooldown penalty, reduced damage cooldown penalty.

[Perks] Adjust -> Upgrades: Level 2 - Afterburners: Removed (included by default), Eyes in the Sky: Moved to Level 2, Full Coverage: Changes missile swarm pattern to 4x5 (was 3x5); Level 3 - Supersonic: Ultimate launch time reduced ~50%, Aerial Expert: Improves jetpack horizontal speed, significantly improves handling, decreases initial fuel consumption, slightly reduces total fuel.
[Tactical] Fix -> Tac now working inside of D.O.C. Halo and near Dome of Protection’s edges
[Perks] Adjust -> Full Tank upgrade now includes a 50% reduction in refuel delay to 4s.
[Passive] Buff -> Gains Threat Vision while jetpacking, stays on until feet hit the ground/zipline

right.name: Perk Niv. 2 Droite
right.description: Eyes in the Sky upgrade now includes a 50% reduction in refuel delay to 4s.

right.name: Perk Niv. 3 Droite
right.description: Full Coverage upgrade changes missile swarm pattern to 4x5, and Aerial Expert improves jetpack horizontal speed, significantly improves handling, decreases initial fuel consumption, slightly reduces total fuel.
